{{Top|leg}}
'''Insecticulture''' was a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] term used to describe the scientific process of [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic engineering]] as applied to that cornerstone of the [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]] diet, [[Insect/Legends|''insects'']]&mdash;increasing their stamina and size, and thus supply.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

A science developed at the end of the [[Hive Wars]]—which conflict was the result of dire food shortages on the planet Kubindi—the cultural remnants of ''insecticulture'' were found on other planets within the galaxy, such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. There, [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]] employed a Kubindi gourmet chef who fed chemicals to exotic insects and injected them with growth hormones to cause them to unnaturally mutate and increase in size, with the aim of improving taste.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children">''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]''</ref>
